main.description: A Visual Studio Code extension showing remaining 5-hour and weekly quota for the selected local or remote Codex CLI account.
main.trust: Quota queries execute Codex CLI on the selected host.
selectEnvironment: Codex Quota: Choose local / remote environment
togglePosition: Codex Quota: Switch status bar side
showAccount: Codex Quota: View account and quota source
executionEnvironment: Quota query environment. Changes apply immediately; remote queries require Codex Quota Remote on the remote host.
statusBarPosition: Status bar side. Changes apply immediately.
cliPath: Local Codex executable path (or the official npm CLI .js entry). Configure in local user settings; shell commands are not accepted.
codexHome: Local Codex configuration directory. Leave empty to inherit local CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex. Supports ~/. Credentials are not read by this extension.
remoteCliPath: Codex CLI path on the remote host. Configure in remote user settings; shell commands are not accepted.
remoteCodexHome: Codex configuration directory on the remote host. Leave empty to inherit remote CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex. Supports ~/.
requestTimeoutSeconds: Timeout for the entire quota query in seconds.
language: Display language for the extension menus, status bar, tooltips and errors. Changes apply immediately.
language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
showPublicIp: Show the selected host’s public outbound IP using HTTPS ipify. Cached for five minutes; failure does not prevent quota queries.
